title.zh: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
title.en: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份

current_state.zh: Metaplanet announced a ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bond maturing October 2031, using ¥23.6B to repay bitcoin-backed borrowings and up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks, with no proceeds going directly to additional BTC purchases.
